environment: Local built Worker with real Wrangler local D1 binding DB, isolated synthetic SQLite state, direct user Worker listener; no Sites or hosted D1

protocol.clock: client performance.now(), request through JSON parse
protocol.responseBytes: decompressed UTF-8 body bytes from Node fetch; response Content-Encoding is gzip; these are not compressed wire bytes
protocol.previewApplyMetric: sum of the two measured RPC durations; excludes metrics instrumentation, UI debounce and rendering
protocol.quantiles: nearest-rank over pooled raw samples; per-round medians retained; no statistical significance claim
protocol.initialDatabase: Seeded once through local D1 CLI in before checkout and copied while closed to after checkout before either run
protocol.fixtures: deterministic synthetic Actions, Notes, projects/tags, depth-3 containment, mixed status, Defer/Due, three saved perspectives and two Tag associations per Action

representation.kind: sum of preview and apply responses
